question: For each network that has at least one port bound to a security group, with admin_state_up = 1 and belonging to tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', list the network ID and the maximum (across ports in that network) of the per-port security group binding count and the per-port DNS record count. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH port_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    p.network_id,
    p.id AS port_id,
    COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS sg_binding_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM portdnses pd WHERE pd.port_id = p.id) AS dns_record_count
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1
    AND p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57'
  GROUP BY p.network_id, p.id
)
SELECT
  n.id AS network_id,
  MAX(pm.sg_binding_count) AS max_sg_binding_count,
  MAX(pm.dns_record_count) AS max_dns_record_count
FROM port_metrics pm
JOIN networks n ON n.id = pm.network_id
GROUP BY n.id
